definitions.explanation: The condition of not being a citizen of any country. A legal status recognized in international law.

definitions.gloss: having no distinct national character; cosmopolitan; borderless
definitions.explanation: Used figuratively to describe food, music, fashion, or spaces that blend elements from multiple cultures without belonging to any single one.

notes:
{無国籍|むこくせき} uses the prefix ⟦{無|む}→無：17750_mu⟧ (without) + ⟦{国籍|こくせき}→国籍：02755_kokuseki⟧ (nationality).

The figurative sense (sense 2) is common in food and lifestyle contexts. {無国籍|むこくせき}⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧ refers to fusion cuisine that blends ingredients and techniques from multiple countries without fitting neatly into any single culinary tradition.
